i am curious about multi-view training.
did it not over fit in training?

(or is my transformer encoder too strong)?

@hengck23 Thank your for the question! We learnt a lot from your discussion topics (as usual 😊).
With regard to multi-view training, we tried efficientnet, convnext, seresnext, nextvit, and some other backbones, and none of them significantly overfitted. Compared to fusion models with stronger spatial regularization, normal multi-view models usually were slightly overfitted after the same training epochs, but we did not observe big differences.

Congratulations and Thank you for sharing your solution. Looking forward to the github code.

I'm trying to understand Stepwise Rejection Ensemble -
You start with predictions for Model 1 and Model 2 and bottom 25% probability samples will not be predicted by Model 3 and Model 4 ? Is that correct or did I misunderstand ?

Thank you for the question, let me clarify:

[1st stage] [100% test data] x [model 1, model 2]
-> bottom 25% were removed and labelled as 0
[2nd stage] [75% test data] x ([model 1, model 2] from 1st stage + [model 3])
-> bottom 40% (x 75%) were removed and labelled as 0
[3rd stage] [45% test data] x ([model 1, model 2, model 3] from 2nd stage + [model 4])

In this way, additional models are run only on suspicious data.
